unit.direction_note: Nagao's unit is one F_2 Macaulay operation; vOW's is one E(F_2^n) group operation (>= one field inversion + 2 multiplications ~ n^2 bit ops schoolbook, ~ n log n with fast arithmetic). Putting both in bit operations multiplies vOW's count, so every conversion RAISES vOW and makes margin = Nagao - vOW MORE negative: it cannot erase a flag.
